response.justification: Despite extensive software experience, the candidate lacks direct C++ development experience in industrial automation or high-performance systems, with only a brief, non-detailed mention of C++ in a 2014 academic thesis and NI LabWindows role; core requirements like STL, multi-threading, message brokers, IEC 62443, and industrial protocols are absent, and their recent work is dominated by TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang — not aligned with the role’s C++-centric, security-compliant, on-prem/cloud industrial platform focus.
strengths: Strong full-stack and cross-platform development experience across diverse systems
Proven track record in open-source contributions and technical education
Extensive background in event-driven architectures and distributed systems
concerns: Minimal recent or relevant C++/STL experience for core role responsibilities
No evidence of industrial cybersecurity standards (IEC 62443) or OT protocols
Primary tech stack (TypeScript, Node.js, DLang) diverges significantly from required C++ focus
